__task_type_notes__: estimation_or_reconstruction: RGB is used as the condition to generate a non-RGB modality; this covers reconstruction-style tasks such as RGB-to-3D/spatial information.
conditional_control: a non-RGB modality is used as the condition to generate RGB or another non-RGB modality.
conditional_control+narrow_generation: caption and a non-RGB modality are used together to generate RGB; this is both conditional control and caption-driven narrow generation.

general_generation: caption alone is used as the condition to generate any modality; currently not planned for training because RGB can be generated first and other modalities can then be reconstructed/estimated.
narrow_generation: caption alone is used as the condition to generate RGB; base text-to-image/text-to-video models belong to this category.
inverse_rendering: RGB plus another modality are used together as conditions to generate a non-RGB modality.
